implementation.inference_framework: transformers 4.40.1, dinosiglip-vit-so-224px + Llama-2-7b-hf, 256-bin discretized action head
implementation.repository: pi05-libero-plus-pro-eval (internal harness fork; not a public repo, no git history recorded)

notes: Per-suite specialist checkpoints (no single unified weight): openvla/openvla-7b-finetuned-libero-{spatial,object,goal,10} (official HF releases). action_horizon=1 (replan every environment step, no action chunk). max_steps per suite: libero_spatial=220, libero_object=280, libero_goal=300, libero_10=520 (same protocol as pi05_libero). Same-distribution evaluation: each checkpoint evaluated only on the suite it was fine-tuned on.

protocol.max_steps_policy: per-suite fixed: spatial=220 object=280 goal=300 libero_10=520

provenance.hardware: 8x NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 32GB (single GPU per run)
